what: Blurry blobs of light move in straight lines from the center to the right → bottom → left → top vertices in turn, tracing a diamond — radius 13vmin, one loop per 9s. Two of differing size·length laid behind both sides of the hero make the background ripple slowly like water

options.--fx-r: Distance to the vertex (via style), default 13vmin — brand left chunk 11vmin, phone 5vmin
options.--fx-dur: Length of one loop (via style), default 9s — brand phone 6s·4s
options.--fx-delay: Delay (via style), default 0s — a negative value starts mid-orbit (to offset the phase of several blobs)
options.dir: back: Rotates in reverse (right → top → left → bottom)

note: this part uses transform — set position with left·top·right and do resizing on the inner child. The blurred blob itself (radial-gradient·filter: blur) is painted in the consuming css

from.where: index.html two light blobs behind the Hero (.ic-fv__blob) — right 13vmin, left 11vmin, both 9s linear (phone 5vmin 6s·4s)
